name: Hitozuma Fitmesu ~Biniku ni Kuikomu Leotard~
original_name: 人妻フィット雌～媚肉に食い込むレオタード～
source:
Kouji Saejima works at a sports gym.
He's an appealing fellow and a popular instructor with a formed body and polite, friendly coaching style.
But there is another side to him that dominates and plunders women, attends orgy parties of the rich and elite where sex is auctioned and bodies are trophies of sexual satisfaction. He is an animal trainer.
And he has just found a new female, Megumi Yuisaki.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061953.html]DLsite English[/url]]

如今，他刚刚发现新的女性目标——结崎惠。
